title: gossampinus angulicarpa
intro: Gossampinus angulicarpa, commonly known as the Angled Wood Apple, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Gossampinus angulicarpa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
